reference.operation: Local BorderBeam prefixCls: classes, inherited aliases, fixed ant beam variables, pseudo-element mask/path, timing and reduced motion. Includes default/empty, overlapping prefixes, cssVar key/prefix, theme aliases, multiple/explicit beams, external portal and independent default sibling. Only deterministic CSS fields are measured; animated distance and hashed keyframe names are excluded.
